_comment: Single source of truth for all superseded and retracted performance figures, strawman numbers, and refuted mechanism claims.
Asserted across all tracked markdown, HTML visualizer, JSON datasets, and benchmark docs by scripts/check_docs_hygiene.py and crates/expanse/tests/test_visualizer_sync.rs.

figures.rationale: Pre-repair random 1M lookup deficit measured under load; quiet host measures 1.031x

figures.replacement: Retracted as unmeasured rescaled instruction counts (~5.52 instr/ns)
figures.rationale: Wall-clock ns figures were rescaled instruction counts, never actually measured

figures.replacement: Bounded keyspace measurement (0.12x-0.55x negative scaling on 50/50 mix, 11.4x on read-only)
figures.rationale: Probed unbounded random u64 keys measuring near-100%-miss descent walk

figures.replacement: Workload E re-measured with symmetric predicate (BTreeMap wins Workload E)
figures.rationale: Asymmetric scan predicate passed ~100% vs ~50% for baselines; 13.2 B/entry for RocksDB is valid and exempt
Strawman static 16-pointer tower baseline vs fair variable-height skiplist

figures.replacement: Unmeasured mechanism tracked in #480 (hardware counter shows 0.042 LLC misses vs 2.74 branch mispredicts)
figures.rationale: LLC miss count is near zero, refuting memory latency bottleneck
